countdown_real_seconds.description: Real seconds between the opening bid and the start of bidding (default 120).

items.description: Money in decimal pounds, at most 2 decimal places (held as integer pence).

max_concurrent.description: Auctions scheduled or running at once across the game (default 1).

turn_real_seconds.description: Real seconds per bidding turn; running out counts as a pass (default 10).
